label: An unrestricted fitting ledger exists exactly for a root with another actual bearer
paraphrase: In each profile at its selected world, some ledger with finite throughput, a positive one-way edge and covered exports for all actually grounded bearers exists exactly when there is an actual root and a distinct actual concretum. The reverse direction builds one unit transfer from the root to the other bearer. Choosing the ledger retrospectively carries no independent warrant for root existence.
